descriptor.name: University of Iowa public mirror of Iowa statewide parcels, 2017
descriptor.operator: Iowa Department of Homeland Security & Emergency Management; University of Iowa public mirror
descriptor.scope: Iowa statewide assessment parcel snapshot last updated at most 2 November 2017; includes Des Moines, Polk County. STATEPARID is source county-qualified parcel code; all rows in its complete source group form the native parcel geometry.
caveats: Historical 2017 snapshot supplied as-is; not current assessment data or a legal survey. Same STATEPARID groups also share source UNPARCELID and PARCELNUMB.
descriptor.attribution: Iowa Department of Homeland Security & Emergency Management; University of Iowa public mirror. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

jurisdiction.basis: Iowa Statewide Parcel Data 2017 snapshot (layer Parcels_20171102) carries all 99 Iowa counties on 2026-10-12; historical, not current.
